fixtures._comment: Build from my writing: every build's prompt starts with VOICE_PROMPT_LEAD (lib/voice-guide.ts). Used by tests/voice-guide.test.ts and the local browser run (USE_AIMOCK=true).

match.userMessage: Write my voice guide from these samples of my writing.

response.content:
Vocabulary: plain, warm words; "culture", "impact" and "shift" come up often. No jargon or corporate filler.
Sentence length: short to medium sentences, two or three to a paragraph. Questions to invite a reply.
Warmth and tone: warm and direct, upbeat without gushing. More formal with new contacts, playful with people she knows.
Greetings and sign-offs: opens with "Hi [first name]," and closes with "Warmly, Simone".
Do:
- Get to the point in the first line.
- Name the shared goal or the impact.
- End with one clear next step.
Don't:
- Don't use exclamation marks more than once.
- Don't hedge ("just", "I think maybe").
- Don't write long blocks of text.
